chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ja'far, from his father, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:
It makes no difference to me whether urine affected me or water, if I do not know.

key_terms.أَبَوْلٌ: is it urine; a ritually impure substance in this context
key_terms.أَعْلَمْ: I know; awareness or knowledge of the impurity
key_terms.مَاءٌ: water; a pure substance contrasted with urine

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if impurity touches a person or garment without their knowledge?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle concerning najasah when a person is unaware of it. It indicates that in the absence of knowledge, the ruling does not proceed on the basis of assumed impurity, which is relevant to ritual purity and salat.
